title: ジャパンカップの後に・怒濤王のキモチ

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aaah… This power… It cannot be coincidence.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am on the brink of awakening as the Centurial Overlord. In order to do so… I must first surpass Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… I-I made it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O loses to Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this is no mere loss. Doto's abilities now match Opera O's, sparking her motivation to improve.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You did well. With this act concluded, is it not time to define our roles between each other?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Answer me, Meisho Doto! Who are you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Are you my lifelong adversary? Do you play a part in Ragnarok, the seemingly endless battle of the gods?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngghhh… Um… Uh…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Will I become your adversary?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I will… NOT!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wha… How can this be?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Poignant words echo through the crisp fall air in Fuchu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: After running with you today… now I know for sure that you're not my enemy, Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're my idol, the one I'll keep running after—as long as I liiiive!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I only got as strong as I am now because of you… And I can get even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're not my enemy, you're… something more comforting. There's no reason for me to want to hurt you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So I want to be your… rival! Not your adversary, but your lifelong rival.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to be the rival who runs with you always—sometimes winning, sometimes losing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I think… I'll be happiest that way.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Happiest, you say…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well then, Doto… I see you have found your answer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then so it shall be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O pulls Meisho Doto to the front of the stands.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me! All fans in attendance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: From this day forth, Meisho Doto will be my closest rival!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I wish for you to watch our beautiful bond as we come to understand one another through our fierce battles on the track.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And I hereby promise this! With a worthy adversary at my side, I will continue to build my shining momentum…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And overcome the Golden Generation at the end-of-the-year Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Will that suffice, my dear friend Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes! Um, also… Please do your best at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So I shall. I'll do my part as ruler of our generation to represent you and Ayabe as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so their tale comes to a happy conclusion, with the two hand in hand as friends and competitors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the real battle starts now. The mightiest generation awaits the mightiest king at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let us be off, Trainer, to the last grand spectacle.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With Doto unable to join, it seems I alone will enter the fray against the heroes of the previous generation…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But fear not! With you at my side, we can overcome anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We exchange looks as we reaffirm our fervent determination. T.M. Opera O then turns to the sold-out stands.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ladies and gentlemen! I am T.M. Opera O! And today, my generation has been unified.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We shall hereby be known as the T.M. Opera Opposition!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As you are well aware, Umamusume are entered into the Arima Kinen based on popular vote.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Which means your support is vital if I am to make it to the top. So hear me now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I beseech you, everyone gathered at this track, to vote for the T.M. Opera Opposition! Together, we cannot be defeated!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She implores the crowd for their votes. Perhaps lost in the moment, she begins sounding like a politician.
